summary: Tested Supervision 2.0 new features: Template CRUD, Action completion toggle, Session Guide in RecordingScreen, and Action rollover styling. All backend APIs passed (9/9). Frontend UI fully working.
critical_code_review_comments: Action completion PATCH endpoint requires action.id field - old meetings processed before this change may not have ids. New meetings will have ids. This is expected per context note.
Session Guide panel header uses template.name ('Supervision Template'), not hardcoded 'Session Guide' - minor UX note but consistent with design.

Rolled-over action amber styling tested at code level (amber-50/amber-200 classes present in MeetingReport.js) - no rolled-over actions in test meeting to verify visually, but code implementation is correct.
seed_data_creation: Template 'Supervision Template' has 'Wellbeing Check' step saved. Meeting 6a3e6204373ddc91df1947cf action_1 was toggled during testing (reset to incomplete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new Supervision 2.0 features verified: (1) Template API: GET returns empty/default when no template, PUT saves steps, GET returns saved steps. Template tab is 4th tab in AdminLibrary (after CQC, Care Cert, Custom Standards). (2) Action completion: PATCH /api/review/{id}/actions/{action_id} works, meeting 6a3e6204373ddc91df1947cf has action_1 with id field. UI shows checkbox with strikethrough on complete. (3) RecordingScreen Session Guide: shows when template has steps - tested with meeting 6a3e59b9758fcdbfbb8dbd1e. Shows template name, step count '0/1 covered', step checkboxes, collapsible with ChevronUp/Down. Rolled-over amber styling code is in place but no rolled-over actions in test data to verify visually.
